# MVP software model

Status: candidate implementation model, 2026-10-26. No application has been implemented or opened to participants. This package turns the [product model](../model/PRODUCT-MODEL.md) and [research protocol](../research/full-protocol.md) into a buildable private developer challenge. Its first public claim is limited to completing three cases and receiving provisional, evidence-linked feedback; it does not claim to identify the best engineers.

| Artifact | Decision it supports |
| --- | --- |
| [MVP experience](MVP-EXPERIENCE.md) | What developers and reviewers can do, screen by screen, and what feedback means. |
| [Participant metrics](PARTICIPANT-METRICS.md) | Exact user-visible dimension labels, calculation and missingness rules, display gates and report example. |

**Selected first pilot audience:** invited adult **mixed software developers**, across declared role/experience/stack strata, using a browser-based challenge at one private study site. This pilot studies usability, case quality and measurement behavior; it does not treat a mixed cohort as one validated hiring population or expose scores to employers. Case content, rubrics, AI, hosting region, jurisdiction, retention and sample size require the decisions listed in the linked documents before real collection.
